title: Pre-Repair Baseline Capture
description: Before any automated repair runs, the full test suite result is captured as the baseline. The baseline is the contract: the repair must fix the failing case without moving any green test to red. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Pre-Repair Baseline Capture
demo.program:
# Automated repair regression check: Pre-Repair Baseline Capture
def repaired(x):  # the repaired function under test
    return x * 2 if x is not None else 0
regression = [(2, 4), (0, 0), (-3, -6)]
for inp, want in regression:
    got = repaired(inp)
    assert got == want, "REGRESSION: repaired(%r)=%r, expected %r" % (inp, got, want)
print("repair under test:", "candidate patch P-7")
print("suite:", "full suite baseline: 412 green", "-", len(regression), "prior behaviors preserved - OK")
